name: MD5 Cloud Decryptor
summary: MD5 Cloud Decryptor is a utility Expert Advisor that connects to cloud-based MD5 hash decryption services to resolve hash values. It does not execute any trading operations and serves purely as an informational/analytical tool within the MetaTrader 5 environment.
summary_zh: MD5 Cloud Decryptor是一个工具类EA，连接云端MD5哈希解密服务来解析哈希值。它不执行任何交易操作，纯粹作为MetaTrader 5环境中的信息/分析工具使用。
strategy_analysis: 该EA并非交易策略程序，而是一个工具类应用程序，主要功能是通过网络请求连接云端MD5解密数据库来破解或查询MD5哈希值。其不涉及任何入场条件或出场条件的设计，因为没有交易信号的生成逻辑。仓位管理和资金管理在此EA中完全不适用，因为它不会开仓或管理任何交易头寸。该工具的核心逻辑在于构造HTTP请求、发送哈希值到云端API、解析返回结果并展示给用户。整体设计思路偏向于网络通信与数据解析，与金融市场交易策略无关。
strategy_analysis_en: This EA is not a trading strategy program but rather a utility application whose primary function is to connect to cloud-based MD5 decryption databases via network requests to crack or query MD5 hash values. It does not involve any entry or exit condition design since there is no trading signal generation logic. Position sizing and money management are completely inapplicable to this EA because it does not open or manage any trading positions. The core logic revolves around constructing HTTP requests, sending hash values to cloud APIs, parsing returned results, and displaying them to the user. The overall design approach is oriented toward network communication and data parsing, having no relation to financial market trading strategies.

parameters.name: CloudService
parameters.description: 云端解密服务提供者地址

parameters.name: Timeout
parameters.description: 网络请求超时时间(毫秒)

parameters.name: AutoDecrypt
parameters.description: 是否自动解密新输入的哈希值

pros: 作为工具类EA提供了MD5哈希解密功能，实用性较强
利用云端数据库资源，解密能力优于本地暴力破解
集成在MT5平台中，方便交易者在同一环境下使用多种工具
pros_en: Provides MD5 hash decryption functionality as a utility EA with strong practical utility
Leverages cloud database resources for decryption capability superior to local brute-force methods
Integrated within the MT5 platform for convenient multi-tool usage in a single environment
cons: 依赖于外部云端服务的可用性，服务中断则功能失效
可能存在网络延迟问题影响解密响应速度
不执行任何交易功能，对交易者直接帮助有限
安全性依赖第三方服务，存在数据泄露风险
cons_en: Depends on availability of external cloud services; functionality fails if service is interrupted
Potential network latency issues may affect decryption response speed
Does not perform any trading functions, providing limited direct help to traders
Security relies on third-party services with risk of data leakage
improvements: 增加多个云端解密服务源以提高可用性和解密成功率
添加本地缓存机制避免重复查询相同哈希值
增加结果导出功能以便后续分析和记录
improvements_en: Add multiple cloud decryption service sources to improve availability and decryption success rate
Implement local caching mechanism to avoid repeated queries for the same hash values
Add result export functionality for subsequent analysis and record-keeping

risk_points: 依赖外部网络服务可能导致隐私数据泄露
第三方云端服务可能记录查询的哈希值和来源信息
risk_points_en: Reliance on external network services may lead to privacy data leakage
Third-party cloud services may log queried hash values and source information

summary_en: MD5 Cloud Decryptor is a utility Expert Advisor that connects to cloud-based MD5 hash decryption services to resolve hash values. It does not execute any trading operations and serves purely as an informational/analytical tool within the MetaTrader 5 environment.
